checks.result: Read the full January 2026 BRAK abstract, physical page 4, in both author and official ministry ZIP copies. The more-than-eighteen-year assertion is immediately used to demand an explanation of necessity and support scepticism toward the proposed storage obligation. It is a factual duration assertion, not a forecast or merely a legal opinion.

Independently found, downloaded, read and visually checked official Bundestag 16/11139, 1 December 2008. The government’s answer to question 2 on physical/printed page 3 reports that in a May–July 2008 survey, providers had to draw on section 113a retained data in 934 of 2,186 proceedings. Answer 4 on page 5 separately identifies cases of unfulfilled storage duties. This confirms actual, though incomplete, operation; the correction does not rest solely on a duty existing on paper.

The same government reply, introductory correction on pages 2–3, distinguishes restricted use from suspension of storage. Independently located the official BVerfG 2 March 2010 press release and full judgment; the record likewise distinguishes prior storage from restricted disclosure. Thus de facto cannot reasonably turn the demonstrated 2008 stored-data use into no storage at all.

May–July 2008 actual operation is within eighteen years of January 2026, directly contradicting a continuous absence exceeding eighteen years. March 2010 to January 2026 is less than sixteen years. The narrow finding need not claim every provider complied or every intervening law operated fully.

Minor: it adds roughly two years to a still lengthy post-2010 period and leaves the necessity, proportionality and crime-clearance arguments open. True direction is defensible because extending the asserted period without storage marginally reinforces the exact necessity objection. A clerical date slip remains plausible; favourable direction is not a finding of intent.

required_limits: Do not infer that the 934 cases were solved because of retention or that retention is currently necessary or constitutional.
Distinguish actual but partial storage, restricted disclosure and later unconstitutionality.
Keep the historical duration correction separate from the unresolved central-portal wording.

new_primary_sources.locators: pages 2–3 government preface; page 3 answer 2; page 5 answer 4
